metadata.title: Wide-Turndown Anti-Vibration Vortex Flowmeter | Velomac
metadata.description: A Velomac vortex flowmeter configuration for applications with substantial flow variation and mechanical vibration, with up to 1:70 turndown and 4-level anti-vibration processing.

hero.title: Wide-Turndown Anti-Vibration Vortex Flowmeter
hero.lead: Industrial flow rarely stays at one operating point.
hero.description: Designed for substantial flow variation where mechanical vibration can interfere with vortex detection.

image.alt: Velomac wide-turndown anti-vibration vortex flowmeter with complete transmitter, sensor neck, meter body and flanges

operatingConditions.title: One Pipeline. Several Operating Conditions.
operatingConditions.description: Startup, reduced load and peak demand can place the same measurement point across a much wider flow range than its normal operating condition.
operatingConditions.conclusion: The meter has to stay usable across the actual operating envelope.

flowEnvelope.title: A Wider Usable Flow Envelope
flowEnvelope.description: The wider turndown extends the usable range between minimum and maximum operating flow, allowing the same measurement point to cover more of the actual process cycle.

engineering.title: The Engineering Behind the Wider Range

mechanisms.title: Optimized Bluff Body
mechanisms.text: Vortex-generator geometry maintains detectable vortex behavior across a broader flow range.

mechanisms.title: Adaptive Signal Filtering
mechanisms.text: Adaptive filtering and digital noise processing extract smaller signals as flow velocity decreases.

mechanisms.title: High-Sensitivity Sensing
mechanisms.text: High-sensitivity sensing improves response under low-flow operating conditions.

vibration.title: When Pipe Vibration Looks Like Flow
vibration.description: Mechanical vibration from pumps, compressors and piping can enter the vortex signal environment. Digital signal analysis is used to separate vortex behavior from mechanical disturbance.

modes.title: Adaptive Filter Mode
modes.text: For normal and relatively stable operating environments.

modes.title: Anti-Vibration Analysis Mode
modes.text: For installations affected by stronger mechanical vibration.

measurementRange.title: Measurement Range by Size
measurementRange.description: Check the available flow and velocity range by nominal size and medium.

applicationReview.title: Can One Meter Cover Your Full Flow Range?
applicationReview.description: Send us your actual operating conditions and we can evaluate the usable measurement range for the application.
